messages:
maria (AE): Voltix signed NDA. They want concrete perf numbers + pricing for a POC. Target workload: chat generation, avg 150 QPS sustained, occasional 5–10 minute spikes to 500 QPS. Need burn-in plan, expected latencies, and answers for security questionnaire (KMS, VPC, retention). Can SE + SRE take? Need draft by Mon EOD.

jordan (Sales Eng): I'm on it. Proposed run plan:
- Phase 0 (smoke): 5m at 10 qps to validate routing.
- Phase 1 (sustained): 30m at 150 qps (avg request: 150 tokens out/50 tokens in, seq len ~512)
- Phase 2 (spike): 3x bursts to 500 qps, 5–10 min each, with 15m recovery between.
Goals: p95 <= 250ms hosted, p95 <= 120ms on Dedicated; 99th < 450ms hosted. Use model variant rwd-7b-q4 (compatible quantized) for prod-like numbers.
Load harness: use vegeta + custom input. Example curl payload to target Redwood hosted API:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-7b-q4","input":"<chat payload>","max_tokens":150}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
vegeta example (sustained 150rps):
```
echo "POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" | vegeta attack -rate=150 -duration=30m | vegeta report
```
I'll produce expected token rates and GPU counts after Devon gives capacity guidance.

devon (SRE): For those numbers, Dedicated sizing estimate:
- Model rwd-7b-q4: ~1 shard per 200 qps sustained with batching disabled; with batching (8-16) 1 shard ≈ 300 qps.
- For 150 qps sustained + spikes to 500 qps we recommend 2 shards (A100-equivalent) with autoscale to 3 shards for bursts, or Dedicated pool of 3 nodes with burst policy.
Warmup: KV cache + prefix caching critical — run 10k priming requests (small parallelism) to fill caches before the sustained phase.
Batching config: target_batch_size=12, max_latency_ms=25 gives best p95 tradeoff.
Metrics to capture: p50/p95/p99 latency, GPU util, tokens/sec, queue depth, retry rate.
Quick smoke script I'll drop to the repo after this thread.

priya (Solutions): Security Qs — short answers we can provide to the customer doc:
- KMS: Support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS / GCP CMEK) for Private and Dedicated.
- VPC: VPC peering + Private deployment available; hosted API supports VPC egress from Dedicated.
- Data retention: configurable options (30/90/365/forever); default 30d for hosted POC; can sign deletion SLA in contract.
- Compliance: SOC2 Type II, ISO27001 in progress, annual pen tests, attestations available.
- Human review: We don't surface customer data to humans unless explicitly enabled.
I'll prepare a short one-pager for Voltix's security team.

maria (AE): awesome. pricing ask: Voltix asked for a 3-week POC quote with burst capacity. Can we give a ballpark for hosted vs Dedicated commit? They want cost both as usage and as a reserved monthly commit.

jordan (Sales Eng): ballpark (draft numbers, internal use):
- Hosted (pay-as-you-go): estimate ~$0.25 per 1k tokens served for rwd-7b-q4 under this workload => for 150 qps sustained (assume 200 tokens/request) over 30 days ~ 777M tokens ≈ $1944/month for POC period. Spikes add ~+40%.
- Dedicated (reserved pool): 3-node Dedicated pool estimate ~$9k–12k/month (includes GPUs + support) depending on region + network.
We should run a quick sample run at 150 qps for 1 hour to refine the numbers. I'll add a sensitivity table to the final writeup.

devon (SRE): note: caching and batching can reduce hosted token costs by ~20–35% effectively. Also quantized variants reduce GPU memory and allow denser packing; ask Voltix whether top-tier latency SLOs are required — if so Dedicated with multi-shard is recommended.

ops-bot: :gear: created cluster voltix-poc-1749876543 (namespace: sales/pocs) — will attach logs to the run when started.

maria (AE): blockers: legal wants an IP clause tweak, procurement needs PO contact, security asked about KMS key rotation policy. I added Tom (legal) to the thread.

tom (Legal): quick note — redline for POC: limit data use clause to benchmarking only; add explicit deletion within 30 days post-POC. I'll draft language by EOD.

jordan (Sales Eng): action items:
- devon: drop smoke script + autoscale config (today)
- priya: send security one-pager (today)
- tom: draft POC clause (EOD)
- maria: get Voltix PO contact and confirm spike windows (tomorrow)
Timeline: smoke run Tue 09:00 PT, full sustained + spike Wed 09:00 PT, writeup Fri COB.

maria (AE): thanks — if everyone agrees I'll schedule the runs and send Voltix the test windows.

reacts: :thumbsup: from devon, :eyes: from priya
